BrochureContent.Content: Superbly located residence situated at the front of the popular Gleann Dara estate. Within walking distance of the university, hospital, shopping centre, church, schools, and enjoys easy access to Salthill and city centre.
No. 13 comprises of an entrance hallway, sitting room with open fireplace, spacious kitchen/dining room, utility room, downstairs WC and WHB. 4 family sized bedrooms and a main bathroom WC and WHB.

No. 13 has oil fired central heating, double glazing, built in units in bedrooms, excellent kitchen and utility room with cooker, fridge, washing machine and dryer all included. Spacious rear garden. Superb off street parking to the front with round driveway.

No.13 Gleann Dara is a fantastic purchase for anyone looking to live near the university, or hospital, and enjoys easy access to every city amenity.

Viewing of 13 Gleann Dara is highly recommended.

Details with John Quinn. 091 569 174.
